steps: Go to the official student page at https://spotify.com/student and confirm the exact monthly student price for your market.
Start the Premium Student subscription from that page.
Verify your student status and your institution's eligibility through SheerID (Spotify's third-party verification service) by following the prompts — automatic or manual document upload.
Once approved, pay the student monthly price for full Premium features (ad-free listening, offline downloads).
Re-verify your student status via SheerID every 12 months to keep the student rate, up to a maximum of 4 years total.
If you graduate or stop qualifying, cancel before the next cycle or the plan automatically switches to a Premium Individual plan at the full regular price.
timing: Up to 12 months of Premium Student per verification; re-verify via SheerID every 12 months. Maximum 4 years total. After you stop qualifying, the plan automatically switches to a Premium Individual plan at full price.
